data.summary: Exact linked text-cleanup requirement tests passed: 37 passed with one existing Python 3.13 audioop deprecation warning.

data.rationale: Cleanup requires one stable local text input while operators must be able to rerun extraction without losing the imported source.
data.requirement: The application shall extract supported TXT, Markdown, PDF, RTF, DOCX, ODT, and EPUB project sources into normalized canonical text with self-contained extraction state and report artifacts, and extraction reset shall preserve the registered source document.
data.verification: Automated focused pytest coverage passed for supported extraction formats, canonical artifacts, no-OCR rejection, and source-preserving reset.

data.rationale: Deterministic cleanup must improve extracted text without silently discarding meaningful multilingual story content or creating divergent text copies.
data.requirement: Deterministic cleanup shall conservatively remove page artifacts, repair page-boundary and dialogue structure, detect supported language/script/chapter cues, and persist canonical clean text plus paragraph metadata that does not duplicate paragraph text.
data.verification: Automated focused pytest coverage passed for deterministic artifact removal, structure preservation, multilingual analysis, and non-duplicating metadata.

data.rationale: Provider output is untrusted and must not reorder or silently lose meaningful source text; deterministic rendering and offline spacing changes keep cleanup review reproducible.
data.requirement: AI cleanup shall validate ordered source-derived blocks that cover every non-whitespace source character exactly once, render artifact types deterministically, persist review artifacts, and reapply compatible spacing selections without another provider call.
data.verification: Automated focused pytest coverage passed for exact source coverage, deterministic artifact rendering, review artifacts, and provider-free spacing reapplication.

data.rationale: The UI and later workflow stages need one consistent projection of cleanup state and predictable invalidation after operator changes.
data.requirement: Text Cleanup state orchestration shall build source and cleaned previews from project artifacts, save confirmed manual clean-text edits, apply compatible AI spacing, derive manifest transitions, and reset cleanup or downstream artifacts according to workflow impact while preserving extraction when requested.
data.verification: Automated focused pytest coverage passed for page-state projection, manual edits, spacing, manifest transitions, and cleanup/downstream reset behavior.

data.rationale: Operators need a reviewable and recoverable workflow surface that prevents unavailable actions and keeps visible state synchronized with persisted artifacts.
data.requirement: The Text Cleanup page shall enable actions from project readiness, present source and cleaned previews with edit/find support, expose AI profile and spacing choices, and route extraction, cleanup, cancellation, edit, and spacing actions through its controller with project-state refresh.
data.verification: Automated focused pytest coverage passed for action readiness, previews/editing, AI controls, operation dispatch, and project-state refresh.

data.rationale: Long documents and provider-backed cleanup must recover from cancellation or interruption without publishing mixed-source or stale-profile output.
data.requirement: Extraction and cleanup operations shall persist resumable progress, reproduce uninterrupted output after compatible resume, and safely restart rather than reuse checkpoints when state is corrupt or relevant source/profile inputs are incompatible.
data.verification: Automated focused pytest coverage passed for extraction, deterministic cleanup, and AI cleanup resume, compatible output reproduction, and safe restart.
